programme.title: Mafiosos
programme.desc: No sul os EUA, um xerife tenta manter a paz quando um homem de família desesperado e o seu irmão roubam violentamente um estabelecimento de distribuição semi-legal de fármacos, passando a ser também perseguidos por um executor da máfia de Nova Orleães.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: No seu aniversário, Tyler e mais quatro amigos são levados pela namorada dele para um local desconhecido onde são trancados em quartos, dos quais só saem resolvendo vários quebra-cabeças. Só quando o jogo se torna perigoso é que todos eles percebem que algo está muito errado.

programme.title: The Kitchen - Rainhas Do Crime
programme.desc: Bairro de Hell’s Kitchen, em 1978. Três donas de casa veem os maridos mafiosos presos pelo FBI. Com poucos recursos, decidem ocupar-se pessoalmente das questões da máfia irlandesa, revelando-se inesperadamente hábeis em tudo, da gestão de extorsões à eliminação dos concorrentes... literalmente.

programme.title: Cem Anos De Perdão
programme.desc: Seis homens armados assaltam a sede de um banco em Valência mas tudo se complica quando a gerente desvenda um segredo oculto num dos cofres: os ânimos aquecem entre os líderes e a suspeita aumenta dentro e fora do banco, chegando a pôr o próprio governo espanhol em cheque.

programme.title: A Lenda De Bagger Vance
programme.desc: Rannulph Januh é um herói da Primeira Guerra Mundial que aceita participar num campeonato de golfe com dois grandes profissionais da época, Walter Hagen e Bobby Jones. Durante o torneio ele conhece Bagger Vance, um caddy que o ajuda durante o torneio e possui o segredo do balanço perfeito.

programme.title: Prisão 77
programme.desc: Em 1977, na transição para a democracia em Espanha, na prisão Modelo de Barcelona, um jovem contabilista aprisionado por um desfalque, junta-se a um grupo de prisioneiros que exigem uma amnistia geral ao mesmo tempo que procura uma forma de se evadir da prisão.

programme.title: Silk Road: Mercado Clandestino
programme.desc: A história verídica do jovem Ross Ulbricht, que criou o Silk Road, um posto de vendas não regulado na internet que rapidamente serviu de palco a um negócio de tráfico de drogas de milhões de dólares, e da perseguição sem quartel que lhe moveu o imprevisível agente Rick Bowden.

programme.title: Dia Da Redenção
programme.desc: Kate Paxton é raptada em Marrocos pelo líder de um grupo terrorista. Acabado de regressar a casa, Brad Paxton, capitão do exército americano, vê-se forçado a embarcar numa nova missão de resgate, desta vez para salvar a mulher que ama.

programme.title: Harry - O Implacável
programme.desc: O inspetor 'Dirty' Harry Callahan é obrigado a formar uma dupla com a inexperiente Kate Moore para tentar descobrir e travar uma organização terrorista composta por veteranos insatisfeitos da guerra do Vietname.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Showtime
programme.desc: Mitch é um polícia de carreira forçado a participar num “reality-show” sobre as vidas dos agentes da lei. Trey é um policia mais interessado na imagem que em prender bandidos. O programa transforma-se no mais visto dos EUA, o que se torna perigoso quando um senhor do crime toma de assalto a cidade.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: Quando Joe Braven se vê confrontado com um grupo de perigosos traficantes de droga na sua cabana isolada nas montanhas, ele vai ter de fazer tudo o que estiver ao seu alcance para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: After Depois Do Desencontro
programme.desc: Quando Tessa toma uma decisão que irá mudar a sua vida, as revelações daí resultantes, sobre a sua família e o passado de Hardin, ameaçam inviabilizar os seus planos e pôr um fim ao intenso relacionamento do casal.

programme.title: Ice Merchants
programme.desc: Um homem e o seu filho saltam de paraquedas todos os dias, da sua casa fria e vertiginosa presa no alto de um precipício, para se deslocarem à aldeia que se situa na planície abaixo, onde vendem o gelo que produzem durante a noite.

programme.title: Harry - O Detective Em Acção
programme.desc: Um a um, criminosos que conseguiram escapar à condenação em San Francisco estão a ser assassinados por polícias motorizados a agir fora da lei. E mesmo que o detetive Harry Callahan não morra de amores pelo sistema, ele não vai deixar os oficiais fazerem justiça pelas próprias mãos.

programme.title: Harry - O Implacável
programme.desc: O inspetor 'Dirty' Harry Callahan é obrigado a formar uma dupla com a inexperiente Kate Moore para tentar descobrir e travar uma organização terrorista composta por veteranos insatisfeitos da guerra do Vietname.

programme.title: Tom And Jerry
programme.desc: A rivalidade clássica entre Tom e Jerry renasce quando Jerry se instala no hotel mais luxuoso de Nova Iorque, na véspera do 'casamento do século', e força a desesperada organizadora de eventos a contratar Tom para se livrar do inquilino indesejado.

programme.title: Novos Amigos Improváveis
programme.desc: Phillip é um homem rico e tetraplégico e Dell é um desempregado com cadastro criminal que é contratado para o ajudar. Apesar da relação inicial tensa, os dois acabam por forjar uma inesperada amizade, que mudará a via de ambos.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Um torneio de póquer a bordo de um barco a vapor promete um prémio de 500 mil dólares... e Bret Maverick tenciona ser o vencedor! Mas primeiro terá de escapar à forca e enfrentar um chefe índio matreiro, pessoas ingratas, um saco cheio de cascavéis e outros tantos obstáculos.

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: Em pleno século XIX, o caçador de monstros Gabriel Van Helsing trabalha para uma organização secreta do Vaticano e viaja até à Transilvânia para impedir o Conde Drácula de usar um lobisomem e as pesquisas do Dr. Frankenstein com intuitos sinistros.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar!
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: The Kitchen - Rainhas Do Crime
programme.desc: Bairro de Hell’s Kitchen, em 1978. Três donas de casa veem os maridos mafiosos presos pelo FBI. Com poucos recursos, decidem ocupar-se pessoalmente das questões da máfia irlandesa, revelando-se inesperadamente hábeis em tudo, da gestão de extorsões à eliminação dos concorrentes... literalmente.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: Brimstone - Castigo
programme.desc: No velho Oeste, a jovem muda Liz vive com o marido e os filhos, mas a sua vida vai mudar de forma radical com a chegada de um novo pastor à comunidade, obsessivo e violento, que leva a que ela rapidamente perceba que a sua família vai correr um enorme perigo.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the fourth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Sheherazade
programme.desc: More than just a tribute to the Ballets Russes, this version of Sheherazade by Jean-Christophe Maillot, resonates as the reunion between choreography and the fictive or real beings which have nourished his artistic universe over his thirty year career.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232
programme.desc: In this concert, Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor for the last time as the Gewandhaus Music Director at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005. After seven successful years in Leipzig, the maestro performs J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232), one of the greatest works of church music ever written. Soloists are Ruth Ziesak (soprano), Anna Larsson (alto), Christoph Genz (tenor), and Dietrich Henschel (bass).

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 5 BWV 1018
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 5 BWV 1014 is the fifth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the 'Symphony of a Thousand.' The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.desc: As emoções do futebol jogam se todos os dias. Todas as novidades dos grandes do futebol a caminho de mais uma jornada de golos, polémicas, alegrias e tristezas para Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.desc: Noite das Estrelas é um late show como nunca se fez no País apresentado por Maya que analisam os temas palpitantes do mundo social e cor-de-rosa, com a ajuda de um painel de luxo que conta com Teresa Guilherme, Daniel Nascimento, Adriano Silva Martins, Gisela Serrano e Duarte Siopa.

programme.title: Entre Os Dedos
programme.desc: Após uma derrocada numa obra, Paulo perde o emprego porque denunciou a situação. Em casa, a relação com a mulher deteriora-se dia após dia. Anabela, a irmã de Paulo, vive com o pai de ambos, que sofre de síndrome do ultramar. Bela é enfermeira e o único conforto de um doente terminal. Famílias grandes noutros tempos e que agora se limitam a sobreviver dentro do destino que lhes coube.

programme.desc: 'Minha Terra, Minha Gente' apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 103
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 85
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Manhã de Carnaval
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part IV
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Georgia On My Mind
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Erroll Garner: Belgium 1963
programme.desc: Erroll Garner: Live in '63 And '64?presents two beautifully filmed concerts featuring his classic trio of bassist Eddie Calhoun and drummer Kelly Martin.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio And Ravi Coltrane - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the legendary pianist McCoy Tyner. Tyner has become one of the most influential pianists in jazz history.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Coba
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: La Mambanegra - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: The latin music orchestra, La Mambanegra, combines many musical elements, such as Jamaican or Colombian music, as well as Funk and Hip Hop. Yet, their main musical influence comes from 1970s New York, where during the time Salsa was born.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Christian Scott
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Quantic
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Al Di Meola - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Chick Corea - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: A Quick Sketch
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sienna Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Conservatory Concert Big Band
programme.desc: As part of the International Duke Ellington Conference 2014, we welcome the Concert Big Band of the Conservatory of Amsterdam for a special concert. Under the direction of David Berger, they will play Duke Ellington’s only written big band symphony, ‘Black, Brown and Beige’. It has been more than 70 years since Ellington’s “B, B And B” was played in its entirety during its premiere at Carnegie Hall (New York).

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Django Memories
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Verônica Ferriani
programme.desc: Verônica Ferriani is a Brazilian singer and songwriter recognized for her powerful voice and distinctive musical identity. Her career spans a variety of styles within MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), and she stands out for the intensity and emotion of her performances. In her shows, Verônica presents a mix of works inspired by personal experiences, tributes to her major influences, and selections from her own compositions.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.desc: Sœur Alma, une jeune nonne arrivée depuis quelques mois au couvent des petites sœurs de la vierge Marie est retrouvée morte dans le chœur de la chapelle. programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Joseph Nyandoro, un ex-Président africain, vit en exil dans un village français. Josselin Gramont, un maraîcher, est retrouvé mort, tué par arme à feu. Marleau découvre que la victime et le Président s'étaient liés d'amitié. Cette amitié lui aurait-elle coûté la vie ? Nyandoro envisageait de s'installer définitivement dans ce village, mais la belle Inissa, son éminence grise, le poussait à reconquérir le pouvoir en Afrique.

programme.title: Le Livreur de Noël
programme.desc: Tandis qu’il attend l’arrivée de ses enfants pour fêter Noël, Julien, en CDD dans une entreprise de livraisons est contraint d’accepter un remplacement au dernier moment. Il promet à ses enfants de rentrer avant minuit et les confie à sa fantasque voisine Olga ! Entre une mauvaise fréquentation du passé qui ressurgit et des livraisons inattendues... le père de famille débute une tournée riche en aventures.

programme.title: Shaun le Mouton, le Film: la Ferme Contre-Attaque
programme.desc: Un vaisseau spatial s’est écrasé près de la ferme de Shaun. A son bord, une adorable et malicieuse petite créature, prénommée LU-LA. Avec ses pouvoirs surnaturels, son goût pour l'aventure, et ses rots venus d'un autre monde, elle est immédiatement adoptée par le troupeau. Mais lorsqu’une sombre organisation gouvernementale se lance à sa poursuite, bien décidée à capturer la petite alien, la ferme contre-attaque !

programme.title: Les Malheurs de Sophie
programme.desc: Réalisé par Christophe Honoré Avec Anaïs Demoustier, Golshifteh Farahani, Muriel Robin Sophie doit vivre avec son horrible belle-mère, Madame Fichini. Mais elle peut compter sur ses deux amies, des petites filles modèles, et leur mère, Madame de Fleurville, pour échapper aux griffes de sa belle-mère...

programme.title: Stromae en Intimité

programme.title: Le Pitch Cinéma
programme.desc: Chaque semaine Le Pitch Cinéma vous présente 5 sorties de la semaine. Rythmé et graphique, une mystérieuse silhouette en contre jour devant un grand écran « donne les clefs aux téléspectateurs pour se forger leur opinion » et décider ensuite d'aller voir les films… ou pas !

programme.title: Beau Geste en Public
programme.desc: Production: Black Dynamite Le magazine hebdomadaire consacré au cinéma, Beau Geste, animé par Pierre Lescure, part à la rencontre de son public, en partenariat avec France Télévisions et le MK2 Institut. A travers un cycle de quatre conférences, Beau Geste en public proposera une réflexion en lien avec des rendez-vous cinéma sur les antennes de FTV.

programme.title: Ronisia au Mainsquare Festival 2024
programme.desc: Production Neutra Production Réalisation Alexandre Buisson Tourné le 7 juillet 2024 au Main Square festival Montez sur scène au Main Square Festival avec la talentueuse Ronisia ! C’est la voix de toute une génération. Née au Cap-Vert mais élevée en région parisienne, Ronisia s’est imposée comme une figure incontournable du nouvel âge d’or du RAndB en France !

programme.title: Concerts au Palais Princier de Monaco 2025
programme.desc: Avec L'orchestre Philarmonique de Monte Carlo Direction : Kazuki Yamada Réalisation : Olivier Simonnet Production : Electron Libre Avec : Lucas Jussen : Piano Arthur Jussen : Piano Cette idée de concerts dans la Cour d'Honneur du Palais Princier est née en 1959, une tradition que perpétue le Prince Albert II en invitant à se produire, dans ce cadre unique, les plus grands artistes du moment.

programme.title: Entre Duel et Duo, Jean-François Zygel et André Manoukian...
programme.desc: Réalisation : Jean-Pierre Loisil Enregistré au Théâtre des Carrières de Taillades Une production Morgane Production avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2025 Jean-François Zygel et André Manoukian, ont une nouvelle fois pris rendez-vous pour leur désormais incontournable « Entre Duel et Duo ». Cette année, le tandem profitera de l’acoustique naturelle et de la beauté minérale du Théâtre des Carrières des Taillades.

programme.title: Birds on a Wire - le Chant des Oiseaux (À la Philharmonie de...
programme.desc: Réalisation : Jeremiah Production : La Familia Production déléguée : Oléo Films Avec le soutien du Centre national de la musique Le duo formé par Rosemary Standley et Dom La Nena fête ses dix ans avec un mélange de leurs chansons signature et de nouvelles reprises, pour certaines dans une version avec chœur de jeunes filles.

programme.title: Les 5 Vies de la Terre
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par BBC Studios. 2023. Réalisation : Kiki Lawrance. Cette série explore notre planète et son histoire, ainsi que son caractère unique dans le système solaire, des premières secondes de son existence jusqu’à l’apparition des êtres humains.

programme.title: Les Routes de l'impossible - Balkans, la Vallee des Oublies
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Tony Comiti Productions, avec la participation de France télévisions. 2024. Réalisation : Frédéric Elhorga et Antonin Marcel. Dans les pays dont certaines régions sont très difficiles d'accès, cette série part à la rencontre de celles et ceux qui bravent tous les dangers au péril de leur vie. Pour eux, franchir ces routes de l'impossible est le seul moyen de gagner de quoi subsister.

programme.title: Sur le Front
programme.desc: Réalisation : Martin Lavielle Rédaction en chef : Pierre Grange Production : Régis Lamanna-Rodat et Hugo Clément Une série documentaire coproduite par Winter Productions/France Télévisions. 2026 On imagine que nos vêtements arrivent de l’autre bout du monde par bateau. En réalité, ils sont très souvent livrés par avion !

programme.title: Sale Temps pour la Planète
programme.desc: Série documentaire coproduite par Elle Est Pas Belle La Vie !/MAH Production, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2023. Un film de Morad Aït-Habbouche. Cette série documentaire étudie les conséquences des changements climatiques à travers la planète. Paysages entre mer et montagnes à couper le souffle, météo ensoleillée une grande partie de l’année, l’île de beauté mérite bien son nom.

programme.title: Le Salaire de la Peur
programme.desc: Long métrage d’Henri-Georges Clouzot Scénario : Henri-Georges Clouzot, René Wheeler, Jérôme Géronimi Directeur de la photographie : Armand Thirard Avec : Yves Montand, Charles Vanel, Folco Lulli, Peter van Eyck, Véra Clouzot En Amérique centrale, quatre aventuriers doivent transporter à cinq cents kilomètres, contre une très importante prime, de fortes quantités de nitroglycérine destinée à souffler un incendie de pétrole.

programme.title: Michel Foucault, le Philosophe et le Poisson Rouge
programme.desc: Un film de Lise Baron Un documentaire produit par Les Nouveaux Jours productions, avec la participation de France télévisions. 2024 2024 a marqué les 40 ans de sa disparition. Californie, 1975, Michel Foucault, philosophe français mondialement reconnu s’apprête à faire un voyage inoubliable... sous LSD. Derrière cet apparent paradoxe, il y a une vie vécue comme une fulgurance, et une œuvre unique.

programme.desc: Une sympathique sorcière, son chat et son chaudron s'envolent sur un balai. Quel bonheur de voler ! Mais le vent se met à souffler très fort, et un dragon affamé vient de se réveiller...

programme.title: Les Moodz
programme.desc: Dans le jardin, Chocotte et Zeveux s'amusent comme des petits fous sur le toboggan. Chocotte est tout joyeux - il glisse sur le toboggan et y retourne à toute vitesse pour une deuxième descente. Mais... PATATRAS ! Chocotte fait un faux pas, essaie de se rattraper sans succès à la poignée et finit par descendre... à l'envers !

programme.title: Silence, ça Pousse!
programme.desc: Présentation : Stéphane Marie et Carole Tolila. Magazine produit par C Because TV avec la participation de France Télévisions. Immersion dans le monde du jardinage avec Stéphane Marie et Carole Tolila, qui livrent conseils et inspirations pour embellir jardins, terrasses et balcons. L’émission met en lumière la place du végétal dans notre quotidien et son rôle dans le plaisir de vivre.

programme.title: Silence, ça Pousse!
programme.desc: Présentation : Stéphane Marie et Carole Tolila. Magazine produit par C Because TV avec la participation de France Télévisions. programme.title: Le Chanvre des Possibles
programme.desc: Un film de Gaëlle Le Garrec Une production Jara Prod avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 De la graine à la fibre, en passant par la tige, le chanvre est un véritable couteau suisse végétal : on le mange, on le porte… on en fait même des parois isolantes! Alors qu’on semble redécouvrir aujourd’hui ses mille usages, le chanvre a accompagné le développement de l’humanité depuis plus de 10 000 ans.

programme.title: K’gari, L’île de Sable
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Wall to Wall Media Ltd. 2023. Réalisation : Alex Burr, Tessa Chan, Ruth Campbell Des tropiques à l’Arctique, l’isolement et la vie entre terre et mer font des îles de véritables laboratoires naturels de la vie sauvage. L’histoire de leurs origines est essentielle pour découvrir leur impact sur les animaux qui tentent de survivre sur ces territoires.

programme.title: Mere Nature
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Plimsoll Productions. 2022. Producteur de la série : Seb Ellis. Cette série dresse le portrait intime de mères du monde animal se battant au quotidien pour leur survie et celle de leurs petits, qu’elles soient de simples proies ou des prédatrices. Dans la réserve nationale du Masai Mara, chaque mère a ses propres combats. Les destins de plusieurs mères se croisent pour le meilleur comme pour le pire.

programme.title: Malte, Carrefour de la Méditerranée
programme.desc: Réalisateur : Juilen Bur et Tamara Petrova. Une production Ampersand. En plein cœur de la Méditerranée, entre Sicile et Tunisie, se trouve un archipel convoité tant pour sa beauté que son patrimoine. Du sommet de ses falaises jusqu'aux profondeurs des abysses, Malte regorge de trésors cachés et insoupçonnés et constitue un véritable carrefour des civilisations européennes.

programme.title: Escapades Aériennes en Italie
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Viacom International Inc. 2023. Un film de Toby Beach. Cette série propose une découverte vue du ciel des magnifiques paysages et de la richesse du patrimoine des différentes régions d'Italie. Cet épisode promet un périple en mer, à travers les plus belles îles italiennes.

programme.title: Les Trésors des Ambassades Parisiennes
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Martange Productions, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2024. Des bâtisses remarquables où l’histoire de la diplomatie rencontre l’Histoire de France.

programme.title: L'apocalypse à l'âge du Bronze
programme.desc: Un film de Katie Reisz Un documentaire produit par TV6, en coproductions avec Discovery Channel et avec la participation de France Télévisions, NHK, SBS, STV, LGI Media. 2023 Il y a un peu plus de 3000 ans, à la fin de l'âge du Bronze, un mystérieux événement a entraîné la disparition des civilisations prospères, des cités et des centres de pouvoir qui fleurissaient autour de la Méditerranée.

programme.title: A Última Tentativa De Hitler T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando um regimento americano se dirige para a costa para libertar a cidade portuária de St. Malo, em França, encontra forte resistência nazi e todas as estradas bloqueadas. Mesmo quando o 3º Batalhão consegue passar, em poucas horas, as forças nazis recuperam o bloqueio na estrada e cercam o inimigo. Sem comida, reforços ou cuidados médicos, dá-se início à saga do batalhão perdido.

programme.title: A Última Tentativa De Hitler T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Dezembro de 1944. Determinado a reconquistar o porto de Antuérpia, Hitler mobiliza uma ofensiva surpresa à Floresta dos Ardenas contra linhas americanas com baixa defesa.
